title: Groups and Symmetry
description: A symmetry is a way to move something and leave it looking the same. Do two, and that is a symmetry too: they form a group. Unlocks the Symmetry Lathe.

puzzle.goal: A necklace has n beads (n a prime) in k colours; two necklaces are the same if one turns into the other. Write how many different necklaces N there are.
puzzle.name: Counting by symmetry
puzzle.ask: Find N for n = @{n} beads and k = @{k} colours.
puzzle.method: Average, over the n turns, the colourings each one leaves alone: all kⁿ for no turn, only the k plain ones for every other.
